content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm facing an issue with the display of Cyrillic characters on my [product_name] operator device—certain symbols are showing incorrectly (for example, 'K' appears as '+', among others). The supplier suggested it could be related to the updates of [product_name] configuration software (latest service and language packs). I am wondering if these updates can modify the character coding table within the operator device. Meanwhile, another identical [product_name] operator device with the same software version does not have this problem. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports incorrect rendering of Cyrillic characters on a [product_name] operator device, with certain letters being displayed as symbols. The supplier indicates that configuration software and language pack updates might be the cause, but another similar device works properly. This highlights confusion about how software updates affect character encoding and language management on the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking consistent and accurate display of Cyrillic characters on all [product_name] operator devices, as well as transparency about how software updates affect character coding and language support.
